alex_csm: morning team — Sparq's private/VPC day0 went mostly green but they reported missing audit entries for outbound egress flows, tagging for network+security triage :eyes:
meera_network: looking. can you confirm which subnet + peering was used? their infra doc said 'edge-subnet-3a' and a customer NAT in their account?
alex_csm: yup edge-subnet-3a, peering sparq-prod->redwood-priv-vpc, NAT is customer-managed. noticed gap around 09:12 UTC when spike hit.
sam_platform: quick theory — our audit-forwarder assumes write perms to their logging bucket via assumed role. if KMS denies Decrypt or the putObject fails, we drop events. can you check CloudTrail->S3 errors?
julia_security: that matches an IAM deny I saw in the initial sample. the role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sparq-inbound-forwarder lacked kms:GenerateDataKey permission for the CMK.
meera_network: traced packet flow, payload reached our edge proxy but forwarding to the collector returned 403 from S3 PutObject. attaching flow snippet.
alex_csm: attaching customer note: "we see spikes, then gap. already told infra to not rotate keys today." they also asked about renewal SLA impact.
julia_security: short answer — if this is a config gap on customer side (role + key policy), it's a low renewal risk as long as fix is quick. if we had to change our integration, it'd be higher.
sam_platform: proposed fix: add kms:Encrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey to their role and update key policy to allow our service principal to encrypt for log writes. sample policy for their review:
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodForwarderEncrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWD:role/redwood-forwarder"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
meera_network: also request they enable S3 server access logs for the bucket for a few days so we can confirm no silent drops.
alex_csm: I'll send the suggested policy + steps and schedule 30m with Sparq infra in 30min. can someone join? @meera_network @julia_security
julia_security: I can join. will prepare a short checklist for auditing key rotation windows and least-priv changes we recommend.
sam_platform: I'll be on standby for testing, can run a small canary to push a few logs once they apply the policy.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy(sparq-forwarder) scheduled at 6139012375 — status: pending
meera_network: after patch, please share the 1-2 minute timeline so I can correlate VPC flows.
alex_csm: noted. also capturing feedback item — sparq asked for a one-pager on "who owns which key/policy for private deploys". action: CSM to produce and attach to onboarding repo.
julia_security: I can draft that with a short diagram and minimum checks (role, key policy, bucket ACLs, rotation window).
alex_csm: great. risk update: marking renewal_risk = "low" for now but reassess if not fixed by EOD. will log this in the account health doc after the call. :white_check_mark:
meera_network: joining the call now.
sam_platform: on call. will execute canary once they confirm. :thumbsup:
alex_csm: thanks team — will post final status in this thread after verification.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy(sparq-forwarder) completed at 6139012380 — status: success
meera_network: verified S3 200s for the canary, flows look normal.
julia_security: key policy change confirmed, no further denies in CloudTrail.
alex_csm: closing loop with customer, adding postmortem note and one-pager link to onboarding repo. great job. :rocket:
